test_cases.description: Verify that `_DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR` in `packages/spec/spec/cli.py` is set to `.specs` (not the legacy `.spec/specs`).
test_cases.input: Import `_DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR` from `spec.cli`.
test_cases.expected: `_DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR` equals the string `".specs"`.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from spec.cli import _DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR; assert _DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR == ".specs"

test_cases.description: Verify that invoking any `spec` command without `--spec-dir` or `SPEC_DIR` resolves the spec root to `.specs` relative to the current working directory.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec list` via Click test runner without `--spec-dir` and without `SPEC_DIR` env var.
test_cases.expected: The resolved `spec_dir` in the JSON output equals `".specs"`.

test_cases.description: Verify that passing `--spec-dir <path>` overrides `_DEFAULT_SPEC_DIR` and uses the provided path as the spec root.

test_cases.expected: The `spec_dir` field in the JSON output equals `"/tmp/custom_specs"`.

test_cases.description: Verify that `spec new` creates `.specs/` and writes `campaign.yaml` with correct content when `.specs/` does not exist, then proceeds with spec creation.
preconditions: A mock PRD file is available.
`Campaign.new_spec` is mocked to avoid actual AI calls.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner in a temp directory with no `.specs/` present.
test_cases.expected: `.specs/` directory is created; `.specs/campaign.yaml` exists and contains `name: default` and `description: default campaign`; exit code is 0.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'], catch_exceptions=False)
  assert (d / '.specs').is_dir()
  yaml_content = yaml.safe_load((d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').read_text())
  assert yaml_content['name'] == 'default'
  assert yaml_content['description'] == 'default campaign'
  assert result.exit_code == 0

test_cases.description: Verify that `spec new` skips auto-init entirely when `.specs/` exists and `campaign.yaml` is already present inside it.
preconditions: `.specs/` directory exists in the working directory.
`.specs/campaign.yaml` exists with `name: existing` and `description: existing campaign`.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner.
test_cases.expected: `.specs/campaign.yaml` is not modified (still contains `name: existing`); exit code is 0.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  (d / '.specs').mkdir()
  (d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').write_text('name: existing\ndescription: existing campaign')
  original_mtime = (d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').stat().st_mtime
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'])
  assert (d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').stat().st_mtime == original_mtime
  assert result.exit_code == 0

test_cases.description: Verify that `spec new` writes `campaign.yaml` when `.specs/` exists but `campaign.yaml` is absent.
preconditions: `.specs/` directory exists in the working directory.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner.
test_cases.expected: `.specs/campaign.yaml` is created with `name: default` and `description: default campaign`; exit code is 0.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  (d / '.specs').mkdir()
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'])
  assert (d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').exists()
  yaml_content = yaml.safe_load((d / '.specs' / 'campaign.yaml').read_text())
  assert yaml_content['name'] == 'default'
  assert yaml_content['description'] == 'default campaign'
  assert result.exit_code == 0

test_cases.description: Verify that `spec new` ignores a legacy `.spec/` directory and creates `.specs/` normally without warnings.
preconditions: A legacy `.spec/` directory exists in the working directory.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner.
test_cases.expected: `.specs/` is created with `campaign.yaml`; `.spec/` is untouched; no warning text appears in stdout or stderr; exit code is 0.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  (d / '.spec').mkdir()
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'])
  assert (d / '.specs').is_dir()
  assert (d / '.spec').is_dir()  # legacy untouched
  assert 'warn' not in result.output.lower()
  assert result.exit_code == 0

test_cases.description: Verify that `--source` / `-s` is a global option on the `main` CLI group with type `click.Path(exists=True)`, default `.`, and is stored in `ctx.obj['source']` as a `Path` object.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec list --source /tmp/src_dir` via Click test runner.
test_cases.expected: Command succeeds (exit code 0); `ctx.obj['source']` equals `Path('/tmp/src_dir')`.

test_cases.description: Verify that `spec new` passes the resolved `Path` from `ctx.obj['source']` to `Campaign.new_spec` as the `source` parameter.
test_cases.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature --source /tmp/my_src` via Click test runner.
test_cases.expected: `Campaign.new_spec` is called with `source=Path('/tmp/my_src')`.

mock_new_spec = Mock(return_value=mock_session)

test_cases.description: Verify that the `campaign` command no longer accepts an ACTION argument and that `open` and `new-spec` are not recognized.

test_cases.description: Verify that `load_theme_config` returns a `ThemeConfig` with hardcoded defaults without reading any config file.

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with patch('builtins.open', wraps=open) as mock_open:

test_cases.description: Verify that `AgentSpecConfig` is a flat dataclass with exactly the fields `model`, `auth_method`, `vertex_project`, `vertex_region` and no additional fields.

property_tests.description: Auto-init is idempotent: running `spec new` multiple times when `.specs/` and `campaign.yaml` already exist never modifies `campaign.yaml`.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For any pre-existing `campaign.yaml` content (sampled as arbitrary YAML strings with `name` and `description` fields), invoke `spec new` N times (N sampled from 2 to 10) with `Campaign.new_spec` mocked.
property_tests.invariant_check: After each invocation, assert that `campaign.yaml` content is byte-for-byte identical to the original content written before the first invocation; assert no exception is raised.

property_tests.description: `campaign.yaml` always exists inside `spec_dir` after a successful `spec new`, regardless of initial filesystem state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of three initial states — (a) `.specs/` absent, (b) `.specs/` present without `campaign.yaml`, (c) `.specs/` present with `campaign.yaml` — invoke `spec new` with `Campaign.new_spec` mocked to succeed.
property_tests.invariant_check: After each invocation, assert `(spec_dir / 'campaign.yaml').exists()` is True and the exit code is 0.

property_tests.description: `spec list` always exits with status 0 and emits valid JSON regardless of `spec_dir` state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample from: (a) `spec_dir` does not exist, (b) `spec_dir` is empty, (c) `spec_dir` contains only non-spec directories, (d) `spec_dir` contains valid spec directories with various `_session.json` states, (e) `spec_dir` contains malformed `_session.json` files.
property_tests.invariant_check: For each sampled state, assert `result.exit_code == 0` and `json.loads(result.output)` does not raise a `JSONDecodeError`.

property_tests.description: `spec list` never includes non-spec directories in its output.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a `spec_dir` containing a mix of valid spec directories (names matching `parse_spec_dir_name()`) and non-matching directories (e.g. `archive`, `tmp`, `random_name`, names without numeric prefix). Sample directory name sets of size 1 to 20.
property_tests.invariant_check: For each generated directory set, assert that every entry in `output['specs']` has a `name` for which `parse_spec_dir_name(name)` returns a non-None value; assert no non-matching directory name appears in the output.

property_tests.description: `AF_SPEC_MODEL` always wins over `[model].model` in the config file when set.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample arbitrary non-empty strings for `AF_SPEC_MODEL` value (e.g. `'STANDARD'`, `'ADVANCED'`, `'CUSTOM_XYZ'`) and arbitrary strings for `[model].model` in the config file. Use `hypothesis.strategies.text(min_size=1)` for both.
property_tests.invariant_check: For each sampled pair, assert `load_config().model == AF_SPEC_MODEL_value` when `AF_SPEC_MODEL` is set.

property_tests.description: `load_theme_config` never reads from the filesystem regardless of what config files exist.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of: (a) no config files exist, (b) `.specs/config.toml` exists with a `[theme]` section, (c) `~/.specs/config.toml` exists with a `[theme]` section, (d) both exist — call `load_theme_config()`.
property_tests.invariant_check: Wrap `builtins.open` with a spy; assert no call to `open` with a path containing `config.toml` occurs during `load_theme_config()`; assert the returned `ThemeConfig` equals `ThemeConfig()` in all cases.

property_tests.description: `spec list` `spec_dir` output is always the configured relative path, never an absolute path.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample relative path strings of varying lengths and depths (e.g. `.specs`, `my/nested/specs`, `specs_dir`) passed via `--spec-dir`. Use `hypothesis.strategies.from_regex(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_/]{0,20}')` for path strings.
property_tests.invariant_check: For each sampled path, assert `output['spec_dir'] == sampled_path` and `not output['spec_dir'].startswith('/')`.

property_tests.description: Auto-init never reads, modifies, or deletes a legacy `.spec/` directory, and emits no warning.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of: (a) `.spec/` exists alone, (b) `.spec/` exists alongside `.specs/` without `campaign.yaml`, (c) `.spec/` exists alongside `.specs/` with `campaign.yaml` — invoke `spec new` with `Campaign.new_spec` mocked.
property_tests.invariant_check: After each invocation, assert `.spec/` directory still exists with its original contents unchanged; assert no text containing `warn` or `.spec/` appears in stdout or stderr.

property_tests.description: `--source` defaults to `Path('.')` for any AI-driven command invoked without `--source`.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each AI-driven command (`spec new`, `spec refine`, `spec generate`) invoked without `--source`, with `Campaign.new_spec` and related methods mocked to capture arguments.
property_tests.invariant_check: Assert that the `source` argument passed to `Campaign.new_spec` equals `Path('.')` in every case.

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that when a legacy `.spec/` directory exists alongside `.specs/`, the CLI ignores `.spec/`, emits no warning, and operates on `.specs/` normally.

result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['list'])

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that `spec new` aborts with a non-zero exit code and a human-readable permission error message when `.specs/` cannot be written due to a permission error.
preconditions: The working directory is read-only (permissions set to 555).
edge_case_tests.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner in a read-only directory.
edge_case_tests.expected: Exit code is non-zero; stderr contains a human-readable permission error message; spec creation does not proceed.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  d.chmod(0o555)
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'])
  assert result.exit_code != 0
  assert 'permission' in (result.output + (result.exception or '')).lower()

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that `spec new` aborts with a non-zero exit code and surfaces the OS-level error message when writing `.specs/` fails due to a non-permission I/O error (e.g. disk full).
preconditions: The filesystem write for `.specs/` or `campaign.yaml` is mocked to raise an `OSError` with message `'No space left on device'`.
edge_case_tests.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature` via Click test runner with `os.makedirs` mocked to raise `OSError('No space left on device')`.
edge_case_tests.expected: Exit code is non-zero; output contains `'No space left on device'`; no partial state cleanup is attempted.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
with patch('os.makedirs', side_effect=OSError('No space left on device')):
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['new', 'my_feature'])
  assert result.exit_code != 0
  assert 'No space left on device' in result.output

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that auto-init applies to a custom `--spec-dir` path: creates the directory and writes `campaign.yaml` if absent, then proceeds with spec creation.
preconditions: A custom directory `/tmp/custom_dir` does NOT exist.
edge_case_tests.input: Invoke `spec new my_feature --spec-dir /tmp/custom_dir` via Click test runner.
edge_case_tests.expected: `/tmp/custom_dir/` is created; `/tmp/custom_dir/campaign.yaml` exists with `name: default`; exit code is 0.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
with temp_dir() as d:
  custom = d / 'custom_dir'
  result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['--spec-dir', str(custom), 'new', 'my_feature'])
  assert custom.is_dir()
  assert (custom / 'campaign.yaml').exists()
  yaml_content = yaml.safe_load((custom / 'campaign.yaml').read_text())
  assert yaml_content['name'] == 'default'
  assert result.exit_code == 0

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that `--source` rejects a non-existent path at parse time with a non-zero exit code and a Click-generated error message.
preconditions: The path `/tmp/nonexistent_dir_xyz` does NOT exist on the filesystem.
edge_case_tests.input: Invoke `spec list --source /tmp/nonexistent_dir_xyz` via Click test runner.
edge_case_tests.expected: Exit code is non-zero; output contains a Click-generated error indicating the path does not exist.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
result = cli_runner.invoke(main, ['--source', '/tmp/nonexistent_dir_xyz', 'list'])

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: first-time `spec new` auto-initializes the default campaign and creates a spec session.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec new my_feature` in a clean temp directory with no `.specs/` directory.
expected_effects: `.specs/` directory is created in the temp working directory.
`.specs/campaign.yaml` exists with `name: default` and `description: default campaign`.
`Campaign.new_spec` is called with `source=Path('.')` and the spec name.
`SpecSession._create` is called and `self._source` is set to `Path('.')`.
Exit code is 0.

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: `spec list` enumerates specs with their session states from a populated spec root.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec list` in a directory where `.specs/` contains two spec directories with `_session.json` files.
mockable: filesystem (pre-populated with spec directories and `_session.json` files)
expected_effects: Exit code is 0.
stdout is valid JSON with `spec_dir: '.specs'`.
Each spec directory matching the naming pattern appears in `specs` array with correct `name` and `state`.
Non-matching directories (e.g. `archive/`) are absent from the output.
Specs with missing or malformed `_session.json` have `state: 'no_session'`.

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: `spec campaign` creates a campaign at a non-default location.
expected_effects: Exit code is 0.
`/tmp/smoke_camp/campaign.yaml` is created with `name: smoke_test` and `description: Smoke test campaign`.
No error output is produced.

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: `load_config` resolves model and provider settings from the restructured `[model]` and `[provider]` config sections.
expected_effects: `load_config()` returns an `AgentSpecConfig` instance.
`config.model` equals the value from `[model].model` in the TOML file.
`config.auth_method`, `config.vertex_project`, `config.vertex_region` equal values from `[provider]` section.
If `AF_SPEC_MODEL` is set, `config.model` equals the env var value regardless of config file.

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: `spec new --source <src_dir>` threads the source directory through the full call chain to the AI session.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec new my_feature --source /tmp/my_src` where `/tmp/my_src` is an existing directory.
expected_effects: Click validates that `/tmp/my_src` exists before proceeding.
`ctx.obj['source']` is set to `Path('/tmp/my_src')`.
`Campaign.new_spec` is called with `source=Path('/tmp/my_src')`.
`SpecSession._create` is called with `source=Path('/tmp/my_src')` and `self._source` is set accordingly.
